task_description: Address post-merge feedback: Codacy reported 6 issues on the merged canary commit 7dbf454. Fix the four real ones, dismiss the false positive with evidence, and close the gate gap that let them pass locally

resolution.semgrep_run_shell_injection: sync-labels.yml interpolated github.event.inputs into a run: body; these are user-supplied on workflow_dispatch. Moved to env and expanded as quoted shell variables.
resolution.sc2086: Quoted gh api repos/${REPO} in enable-github-pages.sh
resolution.sc2001_sc2129: Native parameter expansion and grouped redirects in learn-labels.sh and generate-llms-txt.sh
resolution.agentlinter_gemini_md: False positive suppressed with evidence: GEMINI.md is tracked, 491 bytes, exact casing, present at every analysed commit; verified with git cat-file -e HEAD:GEMINI.md and git ls-files --error-unmatch

root_cause: The local ShellCheck gate ran --severity=error while HARNESS.md documents severity=warning, so the gate was looser than both its own contract and the external reviewer. Raised to warning.
verification: Codacy repo issuesCount on merged main (bd22251) is 0 after the fixes and the evidenced suppression
Whole repo ShellCheck-clean at severity=warning (4 findings before)
Raised gate is non-vacuous: an SC2046 probe fails the gate, the real tree passes
llms-full.txt regenerates byte-identically after the redirect refactor
learn-labels single-match substitution proven equivalent to the removed sed for every real input
Injection payload stored as inert text and never evaluated
yamllint and actionlint pass; actionlint reports no injection
notes: No PR comments, reviews, or review threads existed on #508; Codacy's post-merge analysis of main was the only actionable feedback source. The greedy ${var//pat/} form was rejected because glob semantics over-match relative to sed, which I verified before choosing the single-match form.
